primary_pair_dispositions.summary: Four proposals remain compatible with cognitive attention or care interpretations. Degree sufficiency and due-care standards must be kept explicit; no exact complementary reading is established.
Considerate/helpful nature versus deficient kindness or humane feeling remains supported. The degree boundary and exhaustive division are not established.

Friendlike character and hostile/inimical opposition have supported branches. Helpful inclination versus lack of friendship inclination remains unresolved as a direct alignment. Conditional applicability does not establish a conditional complement.

The adjective pair remains provisionally attested, but the single negative cross-reference does not select a cognitive-attention, care or courtesy interpretation. Neither saved alignment is released for a primary comparison.

Endurance versus irritability is retained in a relevant trying/delay context; broad WordNet impatience also includes restlessness and can overlap with even temper. Eagerness is rejected as this opposite. Conditional applicability does not establish complementarity.

Experiential joy/pleasure versus distress or sadness is retained for the state task. Satisfaction with a specified object is a distinct supported branch. Enduring character and exact complementarity are not established.

primary_review_time: unmetered; overlaps service time; not included in call-cost extrapolation
